def solve(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # blocks: color forming horizontal runs at top/bottom edges; seeds: remaining cells
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    # block color = color of cells in row 0 or last row appearing in runs; seed color = other
    top=[c for c in range(w) if g[0][c]!=bg]; bot=[c for c in range(w) if g[h-1][c]!=bg]
    bcol=g[0][top[0]] if top else g[h-1][bot[0]]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if g[r][c] not in (bg,bcol)]
    scol=g[seeds[0][0]][seeds[0][1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in seeds: out[r][c]=4
    def blocked(r,c):
        return out[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in [s for s in seeds]
    # seed beams: straight down to obstacle/edge
    for r,c in seeds:
        rr=r+1
        while rr<h and out[rr][c]==bg:
            out[rr][c]=scol; rr+=1
    # top block beam: width=len(seeds), aligned toward bottom block columns
    n=len(seeds)
    if top and n>0:
        bmid=sum(bot)/len(bot) if bot else 0
        tmid=sum(top)/len(top)
        cols=sorted(top, key=lambda c: abs(c-bmid))[:n] if bmid<tmid else sorted(top,key=lambda c:abs(c-bmid))[:n]
        cols=sorted(cols)
        for c in cols:
            rr=1
            while rr<h and out[rr][c]==bg:
                out[rr][c]=scol; rr+=1
    return out
